modules.lfm3lab: Lightweight compatibility namespace. Exposes __version__; use submodules, not root model-loading shortcuts.
modules.lfm3lab.research: Convenience imports for protocols, sessions, study execution and reports. All imports are model-free.
modules.lfm3lab.research.schema: Versioned JSON protocols. Constructors expose fields; call validate() or from_dict() to validate the full protocol. Schema validation does not validate native coordinates or tokenize text.
modules.lfm3lab.research.session: Recommended user entry point. Serializes calls, owns backend close, and supports context management. Operation payloads are documented in agents.md; local run calls can load weights, remote run calls can request real inference.
modules.lfm3lab.research.backends: Initial pinned LFM3 adapter, not general model support. Construction/status load no weights. The first valid run lazily loads a model and retains the lifetime lock until close. CPU/MPS loading requires an additional opt-in.
modules.lfm3lab.research.runner: Sequential fixed likelihood trials. Detaches the protocol, journals attempts, validates receipts and returns a report. Time limits stop new trials, not in-flight calls. Started pairs are never silently retried.
modules.lfm3lab.research.store: Advanced evidence storage API. Hold output_lock for every EvidenceStore read or mutation. Protocol/raw receipts are immutable; reports are replaceable. Hashes verify integrity relative to a recorded chain, not honesty.
modules.lfm3lab.research.report: Model-free paired reports. build_report verifies evidence and rewrites derived reports, retaining failed/interrupted/missing counts. It does not execute a model or rerun trials.
modules.lfm3lab.glassbox: PyTorch instruments and native coordinates. Direct primitives require caller-owned Loaded model and inference_lock throughout load/use/unload. Do not overlap hook contexts. Low-level helpers are documented for completeness, not as a general adapter API.
modules.lfm3lab.research.worker: Advanced JSON transport. Connects to existing hardware, never provisions it. Remote close closes only the proxy. Server owners must shutdown, drain server_close, then close the backend. Use SSH/TLS and authentication as appropriate; not a multi-tenant production service.
modules.lfm3lab.model: Advanced loading helper. Import needs PyTorch; load additionally imports Hub/Transformers, downloads artifacts and executes checkpoint code. Its old unpinned default/base alias is retained but is not a supported mechanistic adapter. Prefer ResearchSession.local.
modules.lfm3lab.jacobian_lens: Two retained PyTorch numerical helpers. No Jacobian fitter or calibration API is included.
modules.lfm3lab.research.cli: Installed glass-box CLI implementation; lfm3-research is a compatibility alias. Prefer the command-line interface over parser internals. check requires the instruments extra; examples/validate/report are dependency-free.
modules.lfm3lab.research.checks: Model-free CPU fixture entry points. run_checks needs PyTorch and starts only tiny synthetic modules and loopback fixture servers; it never rents hardware or loads real weights. Call from a guarded main block when multiprocessing spawn is used.

lfm3lab.research.schema.JsonSpec.summary: Serialization/validation mixin for the schema dataclasses; not a standalone study.
lfm3lab.research.schema.JsonSpec.notes: from_dict accepts a JSON dict or the same schema class, rejects unknown fields and returns a validated object. to_dict returns dataclass fields recursively. validate returns self after validation; failures normally raise ValueError (invalid non-JSON values can also raise TypeError).

lfm3lab.research.schema.JsonSpec.from_di.summary: Construct a validated schema instance from a dict or another instance of the same schema class.
lfm3lab.research.schema.JsonSpec.from_di.returns: Validated subclass instance; unknown fields/invalid specifications are rejected

lfm3lab.research.schema.Case.summary: One clean prompt and a fixed target/foil or supplied continuation, assigned to an explicit split.
lfm3lab.research.schema.Case.notes: IDs use safe 1–96-character names. Token texts are exact and whitespace-sensitive. A Case alone may omit target/foil; Study validation requires them according to the objective. metadata must be a JSON dict.

lfm3lab.research.schema.Condition.summary: An input variant and an ordered patch for one fixed condition.
lfm3lab.research.schema.Condition.notes: input_variant is clean or corrupt. patch accepts only rules and norm_mode; schema validation checks structure, not native unit/op bounds. Internal row coordinates are forbidden in studies.

lfm3lab.research.schema.Objective.summary: A fixed likelihood objective and its reduction.
lfm3lab.research.schema.Objective.notes: Kinds: token_margin, token_logprob, continuation_logprob. sum is required for token objectives; continuation supports sum or mean. This does not score generated correctness.

lfm3lab.research.schema.Budget.summary: Durable limits shared by every requested split.
lfm3lab.research.schema.Budget.notes: max_trials is 1..100000 attempted trials. max_input_tokens is 1..4096 predictor tokens; primitive limits can be lower. max_seconds must be positive and finite. Interrupted attempts charge the remaining time reservation.

lfm3lab.research.schema.Study.summary: A written question/prediction, fixed cases and conditions, objective, controls and budget.
lfm3lab.research.schema.Study.notes: Use from_dict or validate before execution. IDs must be unique; baseline_id must name a condition. Study.__post_init__ converts nested specs but does not validate every outer Study invariant. Native-coordinate and tokenizer validation belongs to the adapter. seed is recorded in the protocol, not a general guarantee that every backend seeds randomness. metadata.secondary_comparisons declares unique distinct [left, right] condition pairs.

lfm3lab.research.schema.Study.fingerprin.returns: SHA-256 hex string. Recomputed from the current fields; this property is not a freeze operation.

lfm3lab.research.schema.canonical_json.summary: Serialize canonical sorted-key JSON with compact separators and nonfinite values forbidden.
lfm3lab.research.schema.canonical_json.notes: Raises ValueError for nonfinite numbers and TypeError for unsupported objects.

lfm3lab.research.schema.fingerprint.summary: Hash canonical JSON for a JSON-compatible value.

lfm3lab.research.schema.identifier.returns: None; raises ValueError for invalid IDs

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: A serialized user-facing connection to a backend implementing run, status and close.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: Use a with block or close explicitly. Constructor checks callability, not backend capabilities. backend is public. Close is idempotent; run after close raises RuntimeError. status delegates to the backend, including after session close; backend behavior determines the result.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Construct an owned lazy local LFM3Backend; no inference yet.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: kwargs are the LFM3Backend constructor parameters. Real calls require authorized model use; allow_local_model is an additional CPU/MPS check, not compute authorization.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Construct a remote proxy session; no HTTP request until status/run.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: kwargs are token and timeout from RemoteBackend. An example URL is not an active service.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Delegate a versioned operation and JSON payload to the backend.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: May load a local model or request remote inference. See the operation payload contract. Exceptions remain visible; no automatic retry.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Read backend state/capabilities without local weight loading.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.returns: Backend status dict; remote sessions perform HTTP

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Close the owned backend once, waiting for an active serialized session call.
Enter an open session; raises RuntimeError if already closed.
Close the owned backend on context exit, including exceptions.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.returns: None; does not suppress the exception
Score dict with value, objective, input_ids, prompt_length, identity and diagnostics
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: Requires fixed target/foil for token margin, target for token_logprob, or explicit continuation for continuation_logprob. Accepts Objective as a convenience; the wire format is its dict. No telemetry probe is performed by score.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Request activation/projection telemetry for one sequence.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: Payload is not the low-level function signature: lm is backend-owned, chat defaults false, and max_input_tokens is accepted. Clean-source donors require explicit donor_prompt.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Request local activation-times-gradient attribution for a token margin.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: No continuation attribution or clean-source donors. Optional target/foil auto-selection is observational, not a fixed study objective.

lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.summary: Request greedy cached decoding plus mechanistic replay.
lfm3lab.research.session.ResearchSession.notes: No clean-source donors. A returned continuation is not a correctness or task-benefit measurement.
Uses scope/norm_mode, not a patch. units is only allowed for unique head coordinates in heads mode.

lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.summary: One lazy, mutex-serialized initial LFM3 instruct adapter.
lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.notes: device: cuda/cuda:N/cpu/mps; cuda becomes cuda:0. dtype: bfloat16/float32/float16, optional torch. prefix. revision must be an explicit 40-hex commit; only PINNED is marked verified. status exposes runtime versions and numerical source hashes. close releases loaded weights before dropping the lifetime lock.

lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.st.summary: Return adapter identity, loaded/closed state, versions, source hashes and explicit capabilities.

lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.ru.summary: Validate a JSON operation, lazily load the owned model, then dispatch a score or primitive.
lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.ru.returns: JSON dict with repository/revision/device/dtype and implementation/runtime identity
lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.ru.notes: May perform real inference. Invalid payloads and CPU/MPS opt-in failures are rejected before loading; this is not an authorization mechanism. Calls after close raise RuntimeError.

lfm3lab.research.backends.LFM3Backend.cl.summary: Idempotently release model references, device memory and the lifetime lock under the mutex.

lfm3lab.research.runner.score_payload.summary: Build the fixed score request from a Study, Case and Condition.
lfm3lab.research.runner.score_payload.returns: JSON dict; includes clean case prompt as donor_prompt for clean-source replacement

lfm3lab.research.runner.run_study.summary: Execute each unstarted case × condition pair in one explicitly named split.
lfm3lab.research.runner.run_study.returns: Report dict, with run.requested_split, stop_reason, budget_used and resume
lfm3lab.research.runner.run_study.notes: Writes evidence and derived reports. Does not retry success/failure/interruption. Raises EvidenceError for incompatible/corrupt evidence, OutputLocked for concurrent ownership, ValueError for invalid split/protocol. Ordinary score failures are journaled; KeyboardInterrupt propagates, leaving a pending intent.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceError.summary: ValueError subclass for incompatible, damaged or unsafe evidence.

lfm3lab.research.store.OutputLocked.summary: RuntimeError subclass for an evidence output already locked by another owner.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.summary: Advanced immutable-protocol, journal and raw-receipt storage.
lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.notes: Every operation needs output_lock. Public state includes path, events, trials, responses and (after initialize/load) protocol/study. Prefer run_study/build_report for ordinary use. Do not construct successful result events from unaudited raw files.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.ini.summary: Create a new protocol or verify an existing matching output when resume=True.
lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.ini.notes: Requires an existing locked output directory. Refuses unrelated nonempty output, changed protocol/backend identity or an existing protocol with resume=False.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.loa.summary: Verify protocol, journal chain and referenced raw receipts; populate store state.
lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.loa.notes: Raises EvidenceError; never repairs truncated journals or accepts orphan receipts as results.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.app.summary: Validate and durably append an intent/result/failure event.
lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.app.returns: Event dict including sequence, predecessor and event hashes
lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.app.notes: Advanced event details must match the frozen protocol and raw receipt paths. This method is not a schema-free logging API.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.rec.summary: Journal failure for pending intents without durable completion.
lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.rec.notes: Charges reserved_seconds and never retries. Mutates the journal.

lfm3lab.research.store.EvidenceStore.bud.summary: Calculate durable attempts and elapsed charges, including reservations for pending calls.

lfm3lab.research.store.backend_identity.summary: Keep stable scientific identity fields from a backend status.
lfm3lab.research.store.backend_identity.notes: Requires revision/device/dtype/adapter/implementation; ignores loaded state, uptime, URLs and transport location.

lfm3lab.research.store.output_lock.summary: Acquire a nonblocking exclusive evidence-directory lock.
lfm3lab.research.store.output_lock.returns: Context manager yielding the output Path
lfm3lab.research.store.output_lock.notes: Creates the directory if needed. Raises OutputLocked; releases on exit and leaves the lock inode in place.

lfm3lab.research.store.write_new_json.summary: Create an immutable JSON file exclusively and fsync before journaling.
lfm3lab.research.store.write_new_json.returns: SHA-256 hex str of written bytes
lfm3lab.research.store.write_new_json.notes: Existing paths raise FileExistsError; parent directory must already exist.

lfm3lab.research.store.write_report_json.summary: Atomically replace a derived JSON report.
lfm3lab.research.store.write_report_json.notes: Not for immutable protocols or raw evidence.

lfm3lab.research.store.trial_key.summary: Encode split/case/condition as a canonical JSON key.

lfm3lab.research.report.build_report.summary: Lock and verify saved evidence, then regenerate JSON and Markdown paired reports.
lfm3lab.research.report.build_report.notes: Writes derived files only; no model loading. Numeric deltas are condition minus explicit baseline. Missing/failed pairs are not imputed; declared controls are not automatically passed tests.

lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.summary: Frozen native coordinate: layer, family (h/c/n/res), index.
lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.notes: Use Unit.parse for validation. Direct dataclass construction does not validate coordinates. Residual adjacent out/in names alias a physical checkpoint.

lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.parse.summary: Parse and validate a canonical address against config or pinned defaults.
lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.parse.returns: Unit; raises ValueError for invalid family/layer/index

lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.address.returns: str, for example L2.h0 or L12.res.mid

lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.checkpoint.summary: Physical residual checkpoint key, including adjacent out/in aliases.
lfm3lab.glassbox.Unit.checkpoint.returns: str; raises ValueError for non-residual units

lfm3lab.glassbox.PatchSpec.summary: Ordered rules plus native/frozen normalization mode.
lfm3lab.glassbox.PatchSpec.notes: Constructing the dataclass alone does not validate. Use from_value or validate; at most 4096 rules. Rules accept unit/op/value/mu/scope/positions/source/row. Later overlapping rules win. Native coordinate validation needs PyTorch but no model weights.

lfm3lab.glassbox.PatchSpec.from_value.summary: Normalize None/dict/PatchSpec into a validated native patch.
lfm3lab.glassbox.PatchSpec.from_value.returns: PatchSpec; raises ValueError for invalid patches

lfm3lab.glassbox.PatchSpec.validate.summary: Validate operations, coordinates, finite values and scope.
lfm3lab.glassbox.PatchSpec.validate.notes: Clean donors require source='clean' on residual replace; explicit vectors must match hidden width. mean_scale requires finite mu. The adapter additionally rejects study-facing row selectors and unsupported donor operations.

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.summary: Temporary native activation interventions and optional on-device capture.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.notes: Use as a context manager under serialized model ownership. Capture dictionaries acts/gates/points/inv/parts/routing hold tensors only until exit. reference_copy detaches copies that survive exit. Cached cursors use absolute predictor positions. Remaining nonprivate methods are low-level hook mechanics, not separate session operations.

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.reference.summary: Copy captured denominators and residual points for an explicit reference pass.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.reference.returns: dict with inv and points mappings of detached cloned tensors

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.add.summary: Low-level hook mechanic: register a forward/pre-forward callback and retain its handle for cleanup.

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.positions.summary: Low-level hook mechanic: advance a keyed cursor by x's sequence width.

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.apply.summary: Low-level hook mechanic: apply matching validated rules, masks, row selection and donors to x.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.apply.returns: Activation tensor; unchanged x if no matching rules, otherwise an edited clone

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.projectio.summary: Build the pre-projection edit/capture callback for one unit family and layer.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.projectio.returns: Forward-pre-hook callback; install only within owned hook lifetime

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.residual.summary: Build an edit/capture callback for a physical residual checkpoint.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.residual.returns: Forward or forward-pre-hook callback according to pre

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.norm.summary: Build the post-operator/post-FFN denominator capture/frozen-normalization callback.

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.__enter__.summary: Install temporary capture/intervention hooks and necessary midpoint forward overrides.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.__enter__.returns: The same GlassboxHooks; partial installation is cleaned up on failure

lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.__exit__.summary: Remove hooks, restore forwards and clear captured graph/tensor dictionaries.
lfm3lab.glassbox.GlassboxHooks.__exit__.returns: None; does not suppress the exception

lfm3lab.glassbox.inference_lock.summary: Serialize model ownership across cooperating POSIX processes.
lfm3lab.glassbox.inference_lock.notes: Blocking lock; hold from before loading until weights/graphs/caches are released. Default path is derived from the temporary directory, optionally LFM3_INFERENCE_LOCK. Do not acquire nested lifetime locks on one model.

lfm3lab.glassbox.release_memory.summary: Collect garbage and synchronize/empty accelerator cache for the selected device.
lfm3lab.glassbox.release_memory.notes: Does not remove live references to a caller-owned model.

lfm3lab.glassbox.architecture.summary: Describe the actual model layout and coordinate counts.
lfm3lab.glassbox.architecture.returns: dict with layers, heads, conv_channels, mlp_neurons, unique_residual_checkpoints and conv_kernel_sizes

lfm3lab.glassbox.position_mask.summary: Compute a boolean tensor selecting predictor positions for a scope.
lfm3lab.glassbox.position_mask.returns: torch bool tensor shaped like positions

lfm3lab.glassbox.edit_values.summary: Apply one finite edit to tensor values.
lfm3lab.glassbox.edit_values.notes: Low-level helper; assumes an already validated rule. gate_clamp maps exact endpoints to infinite gate logits; sigmoid endpoints are exact.

lfm3lab.glassbox.prepare_ids.summary: Tokenize a prompt, optionally render chat, move IDs to the loaded device and enforce a token budget.
lfm3lab.glassbox.prepare_ids.notes: No model forward, but requires an existing tokenizer/Loaded object. Low-level chat defaults True, unlike sessions.

lfm3lab.glassbox.explicit_ids.summary: Validate one flat list or single-sequence int64 tensor of vocabulary IDs.

lfm3lab.glassbox.resolve_pair.summary: Resolve distinct token IDs from exact one-token texts, IDs or observational top logits.
lfm3lab.glassbox.resolve_pair.notes: Auto-selection when omitted is not allowed as a fixed Study scoring objective.

lfm3lab.glassbox.token_summary.summary: Summarize a chosen/greedy token and the top logits.
lfm3lab.glassbox.token_summary.returns: dict with token_id, token, prob, logprob, margin and top5

lfm3lab.glassbox.attention_mode.summary: Temporarily select eager attention for routing telemetry.
lfm3lab.glassbox.attention_mode.returns: Context manager yielding None and restoring the old implementation on exit

lfm3lab.glassbox.run_glassbox_probe.summary: Instrument one forward and any required reference/donor pass.
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_glassbox_probe.returns: JSON dict with kind='probe', input_ids, prompt_length, position, target/foil, margin, architecture, matrices/spine/units, temporal readouts, token_trace, routing, vocabulary and DLA limits
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_glassbox_probe.notes: One sequence; prompt token limit 512 or explicit IDs <=768. top_k 1..64; <=32 pins; <=4 c/n vocabulary units. Routing requires <=128 tokens and 1..8 pinned heads. DLA is a frozen-final-norm direct projection, not a downstream causal effect.

lfm3lab.glassbox.run_gradient_attributio.summary: One differentiable forward and autograd.grad for a target-minus-foil token margin.
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_gradient_attributio.returns: JSON dict with kind='attribute', margin, IDs, head_scores/head_timeline, rankings and optional full scores
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_gradient_attributio.notes: One sequence <=256 tokens, top_k 1..64. No parameter gradients are allocated; prior requires_grad flags are restored. Donor behavior is restricted by the session adapter; use session for supported capabilities.

lfm3lab.glassbox.run_head_ablation_sweep.summary: Batched finite zero ablations with matched batch-shape clean comparisons.
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_head_ablation_sweep.returns: JSON dict with kind='sweep', rows (unit/margin/clean_margin/delta_margin), baseline_margin, dtype and batch drift
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_head_ablation_sweep.notes: <=256 prompt tokens, batch_size 1..16. Modes heads/layers/mlp_layers/blocks. units only for unique heads. MPS additionally limits batch_size × prompt_tokens <=1024.

lfm3lab.glassbox.run_glassbox_generate.summary: Greedy cached generation followed by full teacher-forced telemetry replay.
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_glassbox_generate.returns: Probe-style JSON dict with kind='generate', text, generated_ids, cached_token_trace, replay error and timing
lfm3lab.glassbox.run_glassbox_generate.notes: Prompt <=512 tokens; max_new_tokens 1..128. EOS may stop early. Clean-source donors are rejected; explicit vector replacement is allowed. No generated correctness or practical benefit is established.

lfm3lab.glassbox.synthetic_glassbox_chec.summary: Run the 24-layer tiny float32 hybrid CPU fixture with real hooks.
lfm3lab.glassbox.synthetic_glassbox_chec.returns: dict with passed/checks/fixture; raises AssertionError on contract failures
lfm3lab.glassbox.synthetic_glassbox_chec.notes: No real weights, tokenizer or native attention kernels. Requires instruments extra.

lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.summary: HTTP/HTTPS JSON client for an existing worker origin.
lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.notes: URL must have no credentials/query/fragment/extra path. timeout is >0 and <=3600 seconds. token is nonempty printable ASCII without spaces. Proxies and redirects are disabled. close never unloads the remote worker.

lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.ru.summary: POST a bounded versioned JSON operation to the existing worker.
lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.ru.returns: Worker result dict; RemoteError for HTTP failures
lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.ru.notes: May request real inference. Unsupported operations/payload shape are rejected locally; adapter-specific validation happens at the worker. No automatic retries.

lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.st.summary: GET the worker's status through the authenticated client.
lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.st.returns: Worker status dict; performs HTTP but status does not load local weights

lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.cl.summary: Mark the proxy closed without stopping/unloading the shared worker.

lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.__.summary: Enter an open remote proxy; rejects a previously closed proxy.
Close only the proxy on context exit.
lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteBackend.__.returns: None; does not suppress the exception

lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteError.summary: RuntimeError preserving worker HTTP failure information.
lfm3lab.research.worker.RemoteError.notes: Public attributes: status_code and error_type. Invalid worker envelopes/connection failures may raise ordinary RuntimeError instead.

lfm3lab.research.worker.create_server.summary: Bind a JSON server without starting it or taking model ownership.
lfm3lab.research.worker.create_server.notes: port=0 selects an ephemeral port; CLI serve defaults to 8766. Nonloopback binds require a token. Configure exact allowed_hosts if using trusted NAT/proxy. shutdown must be called from another thread before server_close and backend.close.

lfm3lab.research.worker.ResearchHTTPServ.summary: Advanced standard-library server with serialized backend calls and bounded connections.
lfm3lab.research.worker.ResearchHTTPServ.notes: Constructor/server lifecycle methods are inherited from ThreadingHTTPServer. Prefer create_server. Public backend, token, backend_lock, connection_slots, allowed_hosts and server_address are configured by that factory.

lfm3lab.research.worker.ResearchHTTPServ.summary: Advanced server callback: reserve a connection slot or send bounded JSON 503, then dispatch the handler thread.
lfm3lab.research.worker.ResearchHTTPServ.returns: None; normally invoked by the standard-library server

lfm3lab.research.worker.ResearchHTTPServ.summary: Advanced server callback: run a handler and release its reserved connection slot in finally.
lfm3lab.research.worker.ResearchHTTPServ.returns: None; normally invoked by the standard-library server

lfm3lab.model.Loaded.summary: Carrier for a model, tokenizer, repository/revision and device.
lfm3lab.model.Loaded.notes: Construction does not load weights or acquire locks. Caller owns its lifetime; pass this carrier to low-level primitives only under inference_lock.

lfm3lab.model.pick_device.summary: Choose available MPS, then CUDA, otherwise CPU.
lfm3lab.model.pick_device.notes: Not the session default. Session local defaults to CUDA; explicit CPU/MPS opt-in is still needed.

lfm3lab.model.load.summary: Load checkpoint artifacts and execute its custom code on the chosen device.
lfm3lab.model.load.notes: Requires explicit compute authorization and an external lifetime lock. revision=None resolves repository head. The base alias/arbitrary repo string is legacy loader behavior, not verified Glass-Box model support.

lfm3lab.jacobian_lens.sync.summary: Synchronize the selected accelerator; CPU is a no-op.

lfm3lab.jacobian_lens.unembed.summary: Apply embedding_norm then lm_head to a residual state.
lfm3lab.jacobian_lens.unembed.returns: Logits tensor with last dimension vocabulary size

lfm3lab.research.cli.parser.summary: Construct the CLI argument parser without inference.

lfm3lab.research.cli.main.summary: Execute CLI arguments and print JSON results/errors.
lfm3lab.research.cli.main.notes: run exits 0 complete, 1 failed/interrupted/error, 3 incomplete. report exits 0 even when its saved evidence contains failures. validate returns schema-only validation diagnostics; native coordinates and tokenization are not checked. examples exports two protocols, a synthetic walkthrough and a model-free identity-audit helper. run/serve can use real models; validate/report/examples cannot.

lfm3lab.research.checks.schema_checks.summary: Validate protocol roundtrips, fixed objectives and rejection fixtures.

lfm3lab.research.checks.run_checks.summary: Run schema, tiny instrument/backend, runner, worker and example contracts.
lfm3lab.research.checks.run_checks.notes: Requires instruments extra; failures raise. Never loads real weights. A script caller must use if __name__ == '__main__' because the lock fixture uses multiprocessing spawn.
